newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Greenpeace dumps soybeans in Dutch gene protest.
newsitem.headline: Greenpeace dumps soybeans in Dutch gene protest.

text.p: Greenpeace activists dumped 10 tonnes of soybeans in front of an exhibition centre in Amsterdam on Thursday to protest against the shipping of genetically modified beans, Greenpeace said.
A spokesman for the environmental protest group said the RAI centre had been targeted because it was hosting a congress of a new biotechnology industry association.

Greenpeace has held protests around Europe, arguing that the environmental and health risks from genetically modified crops are unknown, and calling for modified beans to be shipped separately from unmodified crops.

"Some of those beans dumped in front of the RAI could be modified, the point is that nobody knows which products have been genetically manipulated and which have not," a Greenpeace spokesman told Reuters.
